test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cc4798d415238a8513909f5c46cd37d01ab3d66e32461294f73b890352e84fb.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Symbol 'arrow in upper direction' and 'Triangle' are getting shifted one place previously in the next image.

Step II: Number '2' and letter 'U' are getting shifted two place previously in the next image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/617d0a52bf41ae871ec0d6383d6721690b6952bce14a8bde3204fe475d48b47a.png] 

Step III: Letter 'B' are getting shifted one place previously in the next image and exchanged with letter 'U' in the next boxes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c60e15272a00a55bd7adaa50b6211663dc2a143e641e6571a6b7e2acce3047c6.png] 

Step IV: Letter 'O' are getting shifted one place previously in the next image and exchanged with symbol 'star' in the last image.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32ccdd0ece533dc6621616ab9f8ed1ac3930de89b4b2c2194239cf65a7913e7b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/935f173ff55229f9ac5269e7dec736cd7e213d510d3f2eebebe899c7bbac9673.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__****The Alphabets is getting replaced with another alphabet/Symbol to the next image. So, in the last image alphabet 'O' is getting replaced with symbol 'Star' according to the options.**
